name: Refactor existing code for improved quality
description: Users asked to refactor, optimize, or clean up provided code snippets to improve readability, remove redundancy, and align with specific architectural principles or modern standards. They often requested concrete rewrites or simplifications across various languages, such as Java, C#, Python, and JavaScript, with a focus on structural integrity rather than just fixing immediate bugs.
